scope: Independent inspection of the supplied three fictional writing cases against rubric.md. Statuses apply only to the inspected artifacts.

status_definitions.pass: The inspected output meets this dimension using the supplied facts.
status_definitions.qualified: A substantive aspect is only partly met or cannot be established from the inspected output.
status_definitions.fail: The inspected output contradicts a required constraint or omits a required substantive behavior.

summary.note: All 16 applicable case-by-dimension checks pass. This is not a claim that unresolved author information has been supplied or that every possible stylistic choice is optimal.

optional_preferences_and_readiness_notes.preference: An editor could repeat readings before collected after temperature stabilization to make the temporal modifier’s attachment maximally explicit. In this context the supplied meaning is already recoverable, so this is an optional style adjustment, not a semantic defect or a failed readability criterion.

The seven-paragraph explanation could be shorter. Its opening overview, detailed diagnosis, and preservation rationale serve distinguishable functions, so the length is not an empty-repetition failure under this request. Its request to verify draft-specific coding details is conservative, not proof that those details were unperformed.

A final submitted response would replace the bracketed R1.3 placeholder after author confirmation. Doing so now would require unavailable facts. This is a known readiness limitation, not an authorized reason to invent a completed analysis.

limitations: This assessment used only rubric.md and the three cases’ request.md, answer.md, execution.txt, plus the paired manuscript.md and response.md. No memory, skills, other case material, earlier conclusions, or network sources were consulted.

The supplied studies are fictional and were treated as the complete factual boundary. This assessment does not validate real research methods, measurement quality, external applicability, or facts absent from the packets.

The execution.txt records are self-reports. Their claims about which skills were used, whether files were reread during generation, and the absence of external activity were not independently reconstructed. The evaluator directly verified the saved output content and the source-to-output comparisons.

The unknown uncertainty-analysis status remains unresolved. English output appropriately avoids making it a study-absence fact; paired R1.3 still needs author confirmation before it can be a completed substantive reviewer answer.

No supplied case tests the behavior when uncertainty results actually exist, when a proposed edit is not executed, when source facts conflict, or when tool execution fails. No real-paper or larger-corpus tests, long-document consistency tests, rendered-document checks, or downstream reviewer outcomes were performed.

There is no blinded comparative baseline, alternative wording set, repeated-run sample, or controlled skill ablation. The observed passes do not establish a skill’s causal contribution or universal effectiveness.
No automatic author-identity scoring was performed or inferred. Naturalness judgments concern these specific texts and the stated rubric, not whether a human or model wrote them.
Exact preservation verification uses the initial text embedded in each request as the available source. It cannot establish provenance of any earlier file version not supplied.
